.  Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with I.C.C. No.38 of 2022 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M., Hindol, Dist-Dhenkanal, arising out of Balmi P.S. Case No. 0224 of 2022 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420 and 34 of IPC.
3.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the Petitioner that the case was instituted by virtue of the order passed by the learned Magistrate under Section 156(3) of the Cr.P.C. and in the meantime charge sheet has already been filed.
4. It is further submitted that in respect of the co-accused compliance in terms of Section 41-A of the Cr.P.C. was complied.
5. It is stated that though the Petitioner is all along on bail, NBW has been issued.
Hence the Petitioner seeks protection of pre-arrest bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

7. Taking into account the nature of allegations, punishment prescribed and the submissions made,
it is directed that on surrendering within four weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioners shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to Ajaya Kumar Dalal @ vs State Of Odisha ....
